hypothesis: Source-feedback query programs can elicit cross-image evidence by jointly observing ALL current images and improve downstream answers beyond a fixed joint query with the SAME tool/images/call count; native H0 is primary.
motivation: v13 generated different single-image observations in all12 pairs but zero final changes or gains. Test the missing joint acquisition operation, rather than revise v13 prompt or threshold. CheXagent native interface accepts image_paths as an ordered list and directly serializes every supplied image.

selection.training: Original24 v9B training cases and their H0_train attempts plus unadjudicated benchmark feedback; all sources retained. Only source text/feedback sent to the one program proposal, no target questions or outcomes.
selection.development: Same six v13 cases, selected as first3 original v7B H0 errors and first3 original v7B correct in input order. v13 outputs inform the joint-acquisition mechanism choice, not case selection. Adaptive reused development.
selection.separation: Source/target case IDs and known canonical image paths disjoint; not a claim of patient-independent evaluation.

policy.schema: admit,tool_name=chest_xray_expert,query_template250-1600chars with exactly one question_stem placeholder,4-24 source_indices,rationale. No generated code.
policy.execution: ONE actual joint call using ALL current2-4 images; same order, same question stem and native tool defaults for fixed and learned. Controller receives only actual returned observations, not explicit query/source.
policy.source_supervision: All24 original B training examples and benchmark feedback, not clinically adjudicated; no target input/outcome/image enters proposal.

execution.current_fact_prefix: Execute exactly ONE chest_xray_expert invocation with ALL2-4 current images in their original order in fixed and learned arms. Same current question stem without options, same tool and native parameters; only persistent query differs.
execution.controller: Original author prompt/current images/six tools/two-turn letter scoring. H0 has no prefix. Matched joint wrapper and current-image-indices raw observations, no explicit query/rationale/source. Tool can echo and hallucinate.
execution.bounds: ONE joint prefix call per case, counted in the same16-tool budget. Further native calls allowed. Observation capped12000chars per joint output identically; full raw logs private.
execution.order: Casewise3-arm rotation; second block reverse target order and shift rotation by1; new Agent/MemorySaver every physical episode, no aliases.
execution.scoring: Read gold only after all predictions or termination; full planned denominators, exact final A-F.
execution.model: Existing local subscription gpt-6.1-sol/high; all medical tools/weights unchanged; no new credentials,API provider or paid resource.

gate.requirements: All36 valid and admitted program. BOTH repeats learned vsH0 net>=2/6 with H0 loss<=1; learned vsfixed net>=1/6; >=2 cases repeated H0 wrong/learned correct AND learned actual controller observation-prefix text differs from fixed in each repeat.
gate.interpretation: Necessary non-identical intervention check, not proof that text differences are medically correct or causal. Solely error-enriched exploratory benchmark evidence, no general clinical accuracy, full-HCL or A-to-B retention claim.
gate.fail: Close fixed policy/variant; no proposal regeneration, target/source resampling, prompt/threshold changes or selective reruns inside experiment.
gate.statistics: All paired gain/loss tables, descriptive exact McNemar, tool-query/evidence coverage, identical-observation nominal gains, per-arm inference/tool/token/rate-limit/runtime costs; repetitions do not increase independent N.

limits.hard_deadline: min(original local implementation/preparation start+4h,windowdeadline); never reset

limitations: Training supervision and tool observations not independently medically adjudicated; this is not Pro E1 or an O-oracle.
Six reused, error-enriched targets from existing B group; single frozen source bank/proposal, adaptive development.
Fixed/learned use same chest_xray_expert, all current images, one joint call and native settings; query lengths not exact token matched; H0 has fewer mandatory calls.
Raw tool text can contain ungrounded interpretations, artifacts or echoes; completed does not imply factual correctness.
Current images only, no historical-patient images sent to tools; no doctor resource fabricated.
public_boundary: Only code,protocol,aggregate,audit,cost; no question/image/label/program content/case identifier/per-case trace/credential.

arms.H0_static: Unchanged native two-turn agent, six tools and current images, no prefix
arms.fixed_joint: ONE chest_xray_expert call on all current images with frozen source-free joint query
arms.learned_joint: ONE chest_xray_expert call on all current images with the single source-only learned joint query

budget.original_clock: From first local preparation, includes all setup, proposal and failure/retry costs

scope: Six outcome-enriched reused B development cases, two repeats, no new cases,96 confirmation cases untouched. No clinical, patient-independent or sequential HCL claims.
